messages:
incident-bot: Pager: Ingress gateway error-rate spike detected in us-west-2 — 502/504s at 17% over 5m. Latency p95 -> 1.2s. Paging oncall @aj.
aj: on it. acked pager, joining. any customer-facing degradations?
priya: seeing a handful of 502s in frontend logs, some retries for streaming endpoints. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /chat/stream.
marta: looking at edge proxy pool, connections to backend inference pods show a lot of TIME_WAIT and aborted handshakes. could be a TLS reneg negotiation pattern.
ben: quick telemetry: load on edge-frontend group spiked 3x after a config rollout ~00:18 UTC to enable "fast-path-routing". rolling back that config now.
ops-bot: config rollback job started: job_id=rb-178945-01, target=us-west-2 edge-frontend.
aj: good. while rollback runs, can we circuit-break slow backends to avoid queuing? set fast-fail for inference replicas if latency > 800ms.
marta: yep, deploying temporary cb policy to prod-edge:
```
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: edge-circuit-breaker
data:
  maxLatencyMs: "800"
  failOpen: "true"
EOF
```
priya: adding a traffic-shed rule to route new non-critical traffic to eu-west as warm fallback. will keep auth/critical routes local.
ben: rollback finished — old routing config restored on all edge hosts (confirm logs show commit rb-178945-01). seeing error rate drop to 6% in 1m.
aj: nice. still want to keep cb policy for a few more minutes. can SLOs/product confirm customer impact?
sam: product: we have 12 customer errors flagged in SLO monitor, none show data loss. Some streams disconnected, reconnects successful. Notifying a couple of power customers via support.
marta: digging deeper — trace samples show header truncation upstream when fast-path-routing was active; proxy attempted to reuse Keep-Alive but trimmed custom auth header on long payloads -> backend returns 502.
priya: can we add strict header pass-through test in canary and add a header-length guard? i'll open a quick patch.
aj: ops, postmortem owners please. marta/priya to lead root-cause, ben to write rollback timeline, sam to coordinate customer comms.
ops-bot: oncall handoff note: aj remains primary until incident clear. next rotation in 2h.
priya: submitted hotfix PR (link) with header passthrough and test + canary rollout to 10% now.
ben: telemetry after rollback + cb shows error rate down to 2.1% and p95 back to 220ms. continuing to monitor 5m.
aj: thanks team. keep thread for updates. if error rate stays <3% for 20m we call mitigated and start incident report. :thumbsup:
priya: noted, monitoring canary results for 10m.
sam: drafting customer note copy, will post to status page if mitigated.
marta: saving trace snippets and logs to the incident folder. will attach to postmortem.
ops-bot: Incident status: active -> monitoring. actions: rollback completed, temporary cb applied, canary patch in progress.
aj: closing loop — if anything regresses ping me immediately. otherwise we'll de-escalate in 20m. :white_check_mark:
